Anthoxanthum.



Anthoxanthum odoratum. Sweet Vernal Grass. (Europe and America.) N. O.
        Gramineæ. Tincture of fresh flowering herb.



Clinical. ─   Coryza. Hay-fever.



Characteristics. ─   This remedy has not been proved,
        but has been used with success on the clinical indication of the effects produced by the
        pollen grains on those subject to hay-fever. It is used both locally and internally. A
        popular remedy for hay-fever is "hay tea," a decoction made of hay itself.



Relations. ─     Compare:
        Cepa, Arsen., Naphthal., Sabad., Psorin.; and its botanical allies, Ananth., Avena, Arundo,
        Lolium, and Sacch. off.
